verdict.rationale: Sentry's documented incident-adjacent capability is alerting: rules that send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks or post to Slack. Declaring and tracking incidents only appears through a third-party integration where Sentry issues are managed from within incident.io. That means the story is delivered only with an extra tool. Missing for 10: native incident declaration, incident timelines, on-call schedules, escalation policies, and any hands-on evidence of the incident.io workflow.
